title: VLCounter: Text-aware Visual Representation for Zero-Shot Object Counting
property: object count (text-specified zero-shot counting on real images)
why_added: trained text-guided counter tested on held-out FSC-147 classes; named by T2ICount, p. 9
reads: Clean RGB photos at 384x384 through CLIP ViT-B/16; one text embedding is added to prompts in all 12 image layers and forms a patch-text similarity map read with patch features by a CNN decoder; never reads noisy diffusion inputs
trained_on: FSC-147 seen classes with density maps; MSE plus rank-contrastive loss for 200 epochs; per-split class counts are not printed
unseen: yes: seen and unseen classes are defined as disjoint (test MAE 17.05); no result by count, smallest printed count 13, and no test with text naming a different class
headline: FSC-147 held-out test classes: MAE 17.05 objects per image against 17.78 for CLIP-Count and 22.09 for ZSC; removing text from its prompts gives 17.19; CLIP ViT-B/16, lower is better
copy_or_avoid: Copy the idea of a spatial text-match map but test it alone on held-out concepts with wrong-word controls, because this decoder always also reads image features and text-conditioned encoders (inferred)

disagreements.claim: VLCounter records new state-of-the-art results on FSC-147
disagreements.paper_says: CounTX, which VLCounter does not cite, prints lower FSC-147 test MAE: 15.73 with class names and 15.88 with descriptions (CounTX p. 7), against 17.05

disagreements.claim: VLCounter improves PUCPR+ MAE by 27.54% over BMNet+
disagreements.paper_says: Table 2 gives 62.42 to 48.94, a 21.6% reduction relative to BMNet+; 27.54% divides the difference by VLCounter's own error (inferred)
